name: OmaKeePick
author: Miroslav Adamec
description: A Listary-style KeePass picker: search a KDBX database from anywhere, auto-type or copy credentials, and see the lock state in the bar.

barWidget.description: KeePass lock state with an auto-lock countdown, plus lock, close and open-database actions.

schema.label: Lock after idle (minutes)
schema.description: Lock the database after this many minutes without a search or an action. 0 never locks on idle. Locking the screen always locks the database.

schema.label: Clear clipboard after (seconds)
schema.description: Clear a copied value from the clipboard after this long, if it is still there. 0 leaves it.

schema.label: Default auto-type sequence
schema.description: KeePass auto-type syntax. A sequence set on an entry or its group takes precedence.

schema.label: Delay between keystrokes (ms)
schema.description: Raise this if characters go missing in slow applications.

schema.label: Delay before typing (ms)
schema.description: Time for the picker to close and focus to return to the window being typed into.

schema.label: Recent entries
schema.description: How many recently used entries the picker lists before you type. 0 lists none.

schema.label: Notify on copy
schema.description: Show a notification, with the clipboard countdown, when a value is copied.
